extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and store listing

extDescription.message: A TOTP authenticator that lives in your browser. Scan a QR code from any page, then fill your one-time codes with a single click.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the store listing

popupEmptyHint.message: Add one by scanning a QR code on the page, or by entering a secret manually.

addDialogSecretHint.message: Base32 string from the 2FA setup page

errSecretCharset.message: Secret must be Base32 (letters A–Z and digits 2–7).

errSecretTooShort.message: Secret is too short. Did you copy the whole thing?

rowFilled.description: Toast shown when a code was auto-filled into a focused OTP input

rowFailed.description: Toast shown when neither auto-fill nor clipboard copy succeeded

rowMore.description: Open the row menu for binding and other actions

rowMenuBindExact.description: Bind only this exact host (no subdomains)

rowMenuBindRegistrable.description: Bind the registrable domain so subdomains also match

rowMenuBindShared.description: Shared hosting domain — only exact match for safety

rowMenuUnbind.description: Remove the binding for this host

rowMenuUnbindTitle.description: Tooltip for unbind action on a previously-bound domain

rowMenuNoHost.message: Open a web page first to bind this site.
rowMenuNoHost.description: Shown in the row menu when no current tab host is available

rowMenuNoCandidates.description: Shown in the row menu when the host is already in the account's bindings

optionsBindingsTitle.description: Title of the settings page section for managing domain bindings

optionsBindingsSubtitle.message: Accounts bound to a domain rise to the top of the popup on that domain. Shared-hosting domains (like github.io) match only exactly.

optionsBindingsEmpty.message: No bindings yet. Use the ⋯ menu on a popup row to bind the current site.

optionsPanelSubtitle.message: When you focus an OTP input, a panel appears below it with the codes bound to the current site.

optionsPanelEnabled.message: Show the panel on OTP input fields

optionsBroadDetection.message: Also recognize inputs by keywords (验证码, OTP, verification code…)

optionsDisabledHosts.message: Never show the panel on these sites

popupSearchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the popup search input

popupSearchEmptyHint.description: Shown in the popup when the search query has zero matches

rowMenuSectionCurrent.description: Section header in the row menu — entries for binding the current host

rowMenuSectionOtherBindings.description: Section header in the row menu — entries for other domains this account is bound to

rowMenuAccount.description: Label suffix on the row menu's delete-account entry

unlockTitle.description: Title of the popup unlock gate

unlockSubtitle.message: Enter your master password to view your codes.

unlockForgotHint.message: Forgot the password? You'll have to clear all account data — there's no recovery.

optionsSecurityTitle.description: Title of the security section in settings

optionsSecuritySubtitle.message: Encrypt all TOTP secrets at rest with a master password. You'll need to re-enter it after a browser restart or auto-lock.

optionsSecurityStatePlaintext.message: Secrets are stored in plaintext. Enable master password encryption below.

optionsSecurityStateLocked.message: Encryption enabled, currently locked. Open the popup to enter your password.

optionsAutoLockMinutes.description: Label for the auto-lock timeout dropdown

optionsAutoLockOption.description: Auto-lock timeout option label (placeholder $MIN$ is the minute count)

optionsEncryptionFailed.description: Generic error message for encryption operations

optionsTransferSubtitle.message: Export all accounts and preferences to a JSON file, or restore from one.

optionsTransferLocked.message: Locked. Unlock before importing or exporting.

optionsExportPasswordIntro.message: Set an export password. The same password will be required to decrypt the file on import.

optionsExportPasswordTooShort.message: Password must be at least 4 characters

optionsImportPasswordIntro.message: This is an encrypted export. Enter the password set during export.

optionsImportPreview.message: File has $TOTAL$ accounts: $NEW$ new and $OVERLAP$ with IDs that already exist.

optionsGaIntro.message: Paste the migration link exported from Google Authenticator, or upload its QR code image. The link starts with otpauth-migration://.

optionsGaQrNotFound.message: No QR code found in the image

optionsGaFromGa.message: From Google Authenticator: $COUNT$ TOTP accounts (of $TOTAL$ total records)
